summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass — including new GET /api/featured-app (week + app shape valid; stable within ISO week) and POST /api/transcribe (200 with text on 1s silent WAV via Whisper, 400 on empty payload). All existing endpoints (/recommend, /categories, /favorites, /history) still green. Frontend: After Expo restart, the new mic-btn renders next to submit-btn; the featured-card 'APP DELLA SETTIMANA · W19 — Duolingo' is visible ABOVE the Categorie grid and tapping it triggers a search that successfully returns results. CRITICAL UI BUG: the Condividi (share) button (testID=share-btn) is COMPLETELY MISSING from /app/frontend/app/index.tsx — the onShare() handler and lib/share.ts exist but no UI element renders inside the result header, so the share feature is unreachable from the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Condividi button with testID='share-btn' is not rendered. The onShare function (lines 171-181) and shareRecommendation() in lib/share.ts are implemented but never wired to a TouchableOpacity. Result header only renders the Nuova button. Feature is unreachable.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings (non-blocking): 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', expo-av deprecation, expo-notifications web push token listener no-op. These are expected per the request and do not fail tests.

action_items: Add the Condividi button next to the Nuova button in app/index.tsx. Suggested fix inside the resultHeader View (after the new-search-btn), e.g.: <TouchableOpacity style={styles.newSearchBtn} onPress={onShare} testID='share-btn'><Ionicons name='share-social' size={14} color='#FBBF24'/><Text style={styles.newSearchText}>Condividi</Text></TouchableOpacity>. Optionally also surface shareStatus toast (state already exists).

Optional: when the user closes the app and reopens, restart Expo bundler — initial bundle was stale on first test run; after `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` the new featured-card and mic-btn appeared correctly. Not a code bug but worth knowing for future iterations: Metro is configured with CI=true so it does NOT hot-reload; bundle is rebuilt only on Expo restart.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/share.ts uses window.location.origin on web — good fallback to clipboard when navigator.share is undefined (tested headless: would copy URL, no error).
server.py /transcribe: tempfile is created with delete=False and never cleaned up — minor disk leak. Not blocking.
server.py: logger is referenced before logging.basicConfig in /recommend exception path was flagged in iteration_1; still not addressed but no failures observed.

rca_of_issue: Missing share-btn root cause: feature was partially implemented — onShare handler + lib/share.ts exist, but the JSX TouchableOpacity to invoke onShare was never added to the result header. grep confirms 0 occurrences of 'share-btn' or 'Condividi' in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx. Reproduction: load home → submit any query → wait for results-section → no share button rendered. Mitigation: add the missing TouchableOpacity (snippet provided in action_items).
